args.title: Asset PR RFQ Converted Auction Split Award

steps.note: Provide the required event title for publishing and later list lookup.
Read the retained PR line quantity on the create screen.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ for vendor quotations.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial RFQ quotation.
Verify Vendor A's quotation was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's initial RFQ quotation.
Verify Vendor B's quotation was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close as required before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ, retaining its quotes and participants, into an auction.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before ranking and awarding.
Open the comparison grid containing both auction bidders.
Verify both real vendor columns are present.
Verify the lower auction amount ranks first, making Vendor A rank 1 at 85.

Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Verify that the split award produced PO lines for both awarded vendors.
Return to the events list to verify the event lifecycle state.
Open the History tab where the closed and awarded event should appear.
